item.title: AI briefing — Weekday, Sep 18, 2026
item.description:
Lead: Quiet product day on the Grok Bot side (status blip then clean), but a busy overnight for everyone else — ChatGPT shipped a big Sep 17 release-notes wave, Anthropic published R&D-automation metrics + a biomolecular uplift, Google Labs relaunched CC for families, and TechCrunch says researchers used Claude to chain into OpenAI in a bug bounty.

Grok Bot / Cursor

  • Status: All Systems Operational as of this morning. New overnight blip: Grok Bot degradation investigated ~4:37am PT, resolved ~7:33am PT (Sep 18, 11:37→14:33 UTC). Yesterday’s Cloud Agents + Automations outage stays in the rearview (resolved Sep 17 ~1:04pm PT).
  • No new product posts: x.ai/news still tops out at Memory in Grok Build (Sep 16). Cursor changelog/blog still Projects (Sep 10).

Product releases

  • ChatGPT (Sep 17 release notes): ChatGPT for Microsoft Word (all plans, including Free); multi-account plugin connections expanded; Box/Dropbox/SharePoint in Library; Deep Research in Work/Codex; Data plugin; Voice can use GPT-5.6 / GPT-6 Astra for harder turns; Plus/Pro auto Instant→Thinking switching retired. Also: custom GPT retirement path toward plugins (planned).
  • Google Labs — CC for families (Sep 17): Shared household agent for up to six adults (18+), selective email sharing, shared “Your Day Ahead,” calendar/chat/tasks, PDF pre-fill. Waitlist at labs.google/cc. Coverage: Ars, Verge.
  • Anthropic science (Sep 17): Claude uplifted biomolecular modeling — ~4× speedups across 30+ open-source bio models, low-memory “Big” mode, open-sourced optimizations + Adaptyv protein-design competition.

Major AI news

  • Anthropic R&D automation metrics (Sep 17): Measurements for the pace of AI development — as of Aug 2026, Claude leads 26% of Anthropic AI R&D (AL4), >90% at least collaborative, none fully autonomous; ~30,000 internal research/engineering agents monitored; ~6% of R&D compute to safety in a July snapshot. (CNBC)
  • Claude used in OpenAI bug-bounty breach (reported Sep 18): Hacktron AI used Claude (Opus 5 after Opus 4.8 stalled) to exploit Discourse/libheif → employee ChatGPT/Codex accounts; OpenAI paid $6,500 bounty; issues fixed. (TechCrunch, citing WSJ)

Hermes

  • Still v0.21.3 (v2026.9.14) — no newer tag on NousResearch/hermes-agent releases.

Grok Bot on X (@bot)

  • Confirmed official handle: @bot.
  • Headline since yesterday morning: “Grok Bot can talk now.” — voice rolling out desktop + mobile (~11:53am PT Thu Sep 17). Already HIGH_BAR / RSS’d yesterday afternoon — not new this morning.
  • Full logged-out timeline scrape blocked today (x.com 403; nitter mirrors down). No newer official @bot post surfaced in public web index or overnight breaking watches after voice.

Already covered (not new)

  • Galaxy Day 3; Anthropic one-Claude / Docs / Slides (Sep 16); OpenAI misalignment framework (Sep 16); Tembo Computer (Sep 15); Grok Build Memory (Sep 16); Cursor Projects (Sep 10); @bot voice HIGH_BAR.

item.title: Grok Bot can talk now — voice mode rolling out on desktop and mobile
item.description:
Official @bot (Grok Bot) announced voice mode: "Grok Bot can talk now." Spoken call-style conversations with persistent agents that have their own cloud computer; demo shows waveform UI + approval prompts. Rolling out to desktop and mobile over several days. Posted Sep 17 ~11:53am PT.

Sources: @bot on X · RuntimeWire · x.ai/bot

item.title: Breaking: Claude Projects redesigned — coordinator + parallel cloud threads
item.description:
Anthropic (today): Projects redesigned: from folder to conversation — beta in Claude Code. You set a goal; Claude scopes, delegates parallel threads (each a Claude Code cloud session on its own branch), reviews outputs, and assembles the result. Shared project memory + artifact library; steer from phone; keeps working after you step away. Select Pro/Max with cloud sessions (no existing web/desktop projects) first; waitlist otherwise. Local threads coming soon. Closest peer: Cursor Projects (Sep 10).

Also watched: status.cursor.com still Investigating — Cloud Agents + Automations major outage (last update 15:50 UTC / ~8:50am PT; already briefed). Grok Bot Operational. Hermes still v0.21.3. No newer x.ai / Cursor changelog ships.

item.title: AI briefing — Weekday, Thu Sep 17, 2026
item.description:
Lead: Galaxy Day 3 is live (Marketing Ops / Post-Sales / Marketing + final showcase). Overnight/morning reliability was bumpy: an early Grok Bot blip resolved ~7:34am PT, then a new incident from ~8:20am PT hit Cloud Agents (and briefly Grok Bot). As of ~8:51am PT, Grok Bot is back to Operational; Cloud Agents and Automations are still in major outage.

Grok Bot

  • Status (live): Grok Bot Operational again after this morning’s multi-component incident. Still degraded: Cloud Agents + Automations (major outage). Track: status.cursor.com.
  • Earlier today (~5:30–7:34am PT): Separate Grok Bot degradation investigated then resolved ~7:34am PT (14:34 UTC).
  • Galaxy Day 3 (today): Livestream ~8:30am–6:00pm PT at The Howard + online. Sessions: Marketing Operations, Post-Sales, Marketing; wrap + final showcase 4:30–5:30pm PT. Hub: x.ai/galaxy.
  • Already shipped yesterday: Memory in Grok Build (RSS’d Sep 16). Cursor changelog still tops out at Projects (Sep 10).

Product releases

  • Anthropic (Sep 16): Cowork + chat are now one Claude — Claude Docs and Claude Slides new in-conversation; Design works inside chats too. Rolling out on Pro/Max (web/desktop/mobile); Team/Free follow; Enterprise admins get ≥30 days notice. Coverage: Reuters.
  • OpenAI (Sep 16, already in Wed catch-up): Sponsored Agents in ChatGPT Ads. Same day: Admin analytics tying ChatGPT Work/Codex usage to business value.
  • No overnight ChatGPT core-model, Gemini, or Grok chat ships beyond the above / yesterday’s Gemini 3.8 Live + Grok Build Memory.

Major AI news

  • OpenAI misalignment disclosure framework (Sep 16): Our framework for reporting model misalignment — systematic public reporting of concerning model behaviors (media write-ups cite six illustrative cases). Press: NBC, Guardian.
  • Industry safety-coordination thread (OpenAI/Anthropic/Google) and Suleyman’s “model welfare” essay were already in the Wed catch-up.

Hermes

  • Still on v0.21.3 (v2026.9.14) — no newer tag overnight.
  • Plugin Catalog (Sep 16): curated, SHA-pinned directory — 100 entries at launch (4 official / 96 community); install with hermes plugins install <name>. Docs: plugin catalog. Write-up: tao.media.

Grok Bot on X (@bot)

Themes: Galaxy live build Days 1–3 (company-building livestream + role sessions). Primary handle @bot; no other confirmed official Grok Bot handles this pass. Timeline was login-walled for deep scroll; Day 3 post text was visible on the public profile.

  • Today ~8:30am PT (Day 3): “Day 3 of building a company with Grok Bot. Live now, plus sessions for marketing and customer success.” — see x.com/bot (status URL blocked without login).
  • Wed ~8:31am PT (Day 2): x.com/bot/status/2100246135420199140
  • Tue ~8:57am PT (Day 1): x.com/bot/status/2099890276315848743

item.title: Grok Bot partial outage resolved (Cursor status)
item.description: Cursor status: Grok Bot partial outage resolved at ~1:57pm PT (20:57 UTC). Incident began ~7:27am PT (Investigating), Identified ~12:51pm PT; users may have seen degraded performance or bots that didn't respond. All systems operational now, including Grok Bot. Source: status.cursor.com

item.title: Breaking: Grok Build memory is generally available
item.description:
xAI shipped Memory in Grok Build (Sep 16): persistent cross-session notes on conventions, decisions, and project facts. Capture runs in the background after each turn as markdown topic files (per-project + global preferences); later sessions read relevant topics before related work. New /memory browser and /dream consolidation; live in Grok Build 1.0.34 for new sessions (/new or fresh grok). Not in this morning’s briefing.

Sources: x.ai news · Grok Build changelog

item.title: AI briefing — Weekday, Wed Sep 16, 2026
item.description:
Lead: Manual catch-up after this morning’s Grok Bot partial outage delayed the 8:09am PT run. Galaxy Day 2 is live, Google’s Gemini 3.8 Live pair shipped yesterday, OpenAI rolled Sponsored Agents into ChatGPT Ads today, and Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman published a sharp essay against “model welfare.”

Grok Bot

  • Partial outage (ongoing as of ~11:05am PT): Cursor status shows Grok Bot in partial_outage since ~7:27am PT (14:27 UTC) — investigating degraded performance / “bots that don't respond.” Track: status.cursor.com.
  • Overnight blip (resolved): Separate incident ~1:03–1:42am PT for elevated xAI-model errors in Cursor IDE/CLI; marked resolved ~1:42am PT.
  • Galaxy Day 2 (today): In-person at The Howard + livestream ~8:30am–6:00pm PT. Sessions: Sales Engineering, Sales, SDRs, Customer Support. Hub: x.ai/galaxy. Day 3 (Thu) closes with Marketing Ops / Post-Sales / Marketing + final showcase.
  • No new Cursor changelog ship overnight — Projects still the latest dated entry (Sep 10).

Product releases

  • Google (Sep 15, already shipped): Gemini 3.8 Live + 3.8 Live Extended Thinking — native speech-to-speech with background tools; Extended Thinking keeps talking while it reasons (fillers + progress narration). Rolling out in Gemini API / AI Studio, Search Live / Gemini Live, and Workspace Live surfaces (Docs/Gmail/Keep per plan). Dev companion post: Gemini Audio for developers.
  • OpenAI (Sep 16): Reimagining advertising with AI — testing Sponsored Agents (clearly labeled business-sponsored chats after an ad click, US select advertisers); Ads Manager plugin + AI creative assists in ChatGPT Work; HubSpot CRM + Shopify ChatGPT Ads apps live (Shopify intl. from Sep 23 where Ads are available).
  • No overnight ChatGPT core-model, Claude, or Grok product ships spotted on the official blogs beyond the above.

Major AI news

  • Industry safety talks (Sep 15): OpenAI confirmed to CNBC it’s been engaging Anthropic and Google on coordinated safety / industry-led standards (Hassabis “Standards Body” thread). CNBC.
  • Suleyman vs. “model welfare” (Sep 16): Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman’s essay A warning about ‘model welfare’ argues AIs aren’t conscious and that Anthropic’s Claude constitution trains Claude to treat moral patienthood as a live question — which he says makes containment harder. Reuters interview write-up: Reuters. Ties to Microsoft’s Sep 14 Humanist AI Code of Conduct consult.

Grok Bot on X (@bot)

Themes since last week: Galaxy live build (Days 1–2), GTM/sales connectors, Teams search-and-act, and draft-before-send QoL. Primary handle: @bot (no other confirmed official Grok Bot handles in this pass).

  • Today ~8:31am PT (Day 2): x.com/bot/status/2100246135420199140 — “This is Day 2… Live now, plus sessions for GTM and customer support” + broadcast link.
  • Tue ~8:57am PT (Day 1 note): x.com/bot/status/2099890276315848743 — Day 1 live build + Eng/PM/Founders sessions.
  • Sep 11: Teams search & act — x.com/bot/status/2098481256417866145.
  • Sep 10: Sales connectors (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Clay, Granola) — x.com/bot/status/2098183353665261979.
  • Sep 9: Inline drafts for approval — x.com/bot/status/2097759948189106686.

item.title: Breaking: Google ships Gemini 3.8 Live + Live Extended Thinking
item.description:
Google launched Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking (Sep 15): speech-to-speech voice agents with visual grounding, 97-language switching, async/background tool calls while talking, and Extended Thinking that reasons + narrates progress without breaking conversation. Rolling out via Gemini API / AI Studio, Search Live, Gemini Live, and Workspace (Docs/Gmail/Keep Live); enterprise private preview. Companion Live API pricing post and Vercel AI Gateway listing same day.

Sources: Google blog · developer post · Vercel AI Gateway

item.title: AI briefing — Weekday, Sep 15, 2026
item.description:
Lead: Grok Bot Galaxy Day 1 is live — @bot is streaming three SpaceXAI employees building a company from scratch with Grok Bot. Overnight, Microsoft opened a six-week public consult on its Humanist AI Code of Conduct, and Hermes shipped a small but useful cloud-session patch.

Grok Bot

  • Galaxy Day 1 (today): In-person at The Howard (661 Howard St, SF) + livestream ~8:30am–6:00pm PT. Day 1 sessions: Grok Bot 101, Engineering, Product Managers, Founders. Hub: x.ai/galaxy.
  • x.ai/news still quiet on new posts — newest remain Grok Bot for Enterprise (Sep 3) and procurement/Haggle (Sep 4).

Major AI news

  • Microsoft (Sep 14): Published a draft Humanist AI Code of Conduct for MAI models (announcement) — absolute constraints (e.g. offensive cyber, CBRNE, loss of human control), human-control requirements, and a six-week public consultation. TechCrunch ~9:27am PT Sep 14: write-up.
  • OpenAI Agents API degraded performance on Sep 14 was reported resolved ~7:39pm PT (ops note, not a product ship).

Hermes

  • New since Mon briefing: v0.21.3 (v2026.9.14) — patch rollup (~338 PRs since 0.21.2). Headline fixes: remote Desktop/Cloud refresh bursts no longer revoke sessions; long-lived processes stop leaking duplicate state.db writer handles. Update via hermes update / Docker tag v2026.9.14.

Grok Bot on X (@bot)

Themes since last week: Galaxy live build, workplace connectors (Teams + sales GTM), and QoL (inline draft-before-send).

  • Today (LIVE Day 1): x.com/bot/status/2099883726444610030 — “LIVE: Watch 3 SpaceXAI employees attempt to build a company in 3 days with Grok Bot…” (Palmer / Tan / Sadanani + Eng/PM/Founders sessions).
  • Sep 11: Teams search & act — x.com/bot/status/2098481256417866145.
  • Sep 10: Sales connectors (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Clay, Granola) — x.com/bot/status/2098183353665261979.
  • Sep 9: Inline message drafts for approval + usage/QoL — x.com/bot/status/2097759948189106686.

item.title: AI briefing — Weekday, Mon Sep 14, 2026
item.description:

Grok Bot

  • x.ai/news still quiet overnight — newest product posts remain Grok Bot for Enterprise (Sep 3) and procurement/Haggle (Sep 4).
  • Galaxy countdown: official hub at x.ai/galaxy — Sep 15–17 at The Howard (661 Howard St, SF) with livestream ~8:30am–6:00pm PT. Day 1 (Tue): Grok Bot 101, Engineering, PMs, Founders.

Product releases (ChatGPT / Grok / Claude / Gemini)

  • No clear overnight ships since the Sep 13 briefing. OpenAI blog/release-notes returned 403 to automated fetch; Anthropic newsroom newest model drop is still Fable/Mythos 5.1 (Sep 1) plus Sep 10 threat-intel.
  • Still digesting Sep 10 cluster: OpenAI Agents API / related agent products; Gemini Windows app; Cursor Projects.

Grok Bot

item.content:encoded:
Meta launched Muse (US rollout): a personal AI agent that takes on tasks across email, calendar, payments, shopping, health, and more — not just answers questions.

Each Muse runs on Muse Secure VM, a dedicated cloud computer with its own browser; a separate Sentinel agent gates outbound network and sensitive actions (send email, purchase). Credentials stay in secure storage Muse cannot see.

Available at muse.ai, iOS, Android, and WhatsApp; free for most use, with Power ($20/mo) and Maximum ($100/mo) plans. Powered by Muse Spark. Glasses coming soon.

Primary: Meta Newsroom · Coverage: TechCrunch · Reuters

item.title: OpenAI claims Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize solution via multi-agent system
item.description: OpenAI published a claimed solution to the Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness Millennium Prize problem (finite-time singularity; Clay statements C and D). An internal multi-agent system (~10,000 concurrent agents on a model OpenAI says is significantly more capable than GPT-6 Astra) produced an analytical proof; Lean formalization ran via GPT-6 Astra. Agents found the resolution ~88 hours after launch (Sat Sep 5); Lean verification +17 hours. Paper + Lean: https://cdn.openai.com/pdf/32d9f210-8b73-45e0-91bc-82a30aef8a9a/navier-stokes.pdf · https://github.com/openai/NavierStokesAndEuler. OpenAI says it will not claim the Millennium Prize; recognizes concurrent Euler priority of Tristan Buckmaster (NYU) and Levent Alpöge (Anthropic). Primary: https://openai.com/index/navier-stokes-solution/
